premises.text: Millions of Americans face a catch-22 where building credit requires already having credit, leaving many unscored or subprime
premises.evidence_span: in order to build or establish credit, first, you need credit. It's a fundamental catch-22

premises.text: Self Lender lets users choose a monthly amount and term, reports payments to credit bureaus, and returns the savings at term end
premises.evidence_span: Self Lender enables our users to build positive payment history, the most important factor in determining your credit score

premises.text: Signup is fast and low-cost at about three minutes and $3 per month
premises.evidence_span: Signing up with Self Lender is easy, takes less than three minutes, and only costs $3 per month

premises.text: Payment data enables exclusive lending offers such as cheaper auto loans, including applying Self Lender balance as a down payment
premises.evidence_span: Self Lender uses her payment data internally to offer her exclusive lending opportunities

premises.text: Serving people without loyalty to mainstream banks creates long-term platform relationships for credit building and affordable products
premises.evidence_span: By helping people who currently do not have loyalty to mainstream financial institutions, SelfLender has the opportunity to build profitable, long-term relationships

value.text: Build credit, save money, and gain access to affordable financial products
value.evidence_span: the new revolutionary way to bill credit, save money, and gain access to affordable financial products

causal_links.evidence_span: Not having credit is expensive and very limiting
build positive payment history, the most important factor in determining your credit score
become the platform of choice for building credit, saving money, and getting access to affordable financial products
